content.what_it_is: Preprocessed (build/pre) Fortran source of FUNWAVE-TVD mixing.F with two subroutines computing time-averaged (wave-mean) fields. SUBROUTINE MIXING_STUFF (L64-89, Shi 05/02/2011): a thin wrapper that calls CALCULATE_MEAN once time>=STEADY_TIME (L71-73); the old long argument-list call is commented out (L74-86), and a ykchoi note (L69-70) doubts Umean/Vmean use elsewhere. SUBROUTINE CALCULATE_MEAN (L119-316; header L94-101 Shi 05/02/2011 with Young-Kwang Choi additions; the old parameterized interface is preserved as comments L103-152): accumulates T_sum=T_sum+DT (L154). When the averaging window closes (T_sum>=T_INTV_mean, L155): first adds the current step to every accumulator — ETA2sum=(Eta-ETAmean)^2*DT+ETA2sum with ETA2mean=ETA2sum/T_sum (placed immediately after the IF so it uses the previous ETAmean, per ykchoi 04/20/2016 comment L229-233; L157-158), Usum/Vsum/ETAsum and means (L160-165), and the radiation-stress accumulators U_davg_sum/V_davg_sum/P_sum/Q_sum, Reynolds-type sums UUsum/UVsum/VVsum=(davg-mean)^2*(Eta-ETAmean+Depth)*DT, WWsum=0.25*Wsurf^2*(total depth)*DT, friction sums FRCXsum=U*sqrt(U^2+V^2)*DT, breaking dissipation sums BreakDiss*_sum+=BreakSource*DT (L167-178) and their means (L180-191); then computes radiation-stress gradient terms over the interior (L195-227): DxSxx=(d/dx)(UUmean-WWmean+0.5*9.80*ETA2mean) by centered differences (L196-198), DySxy, DySyy (L199-202), DxSxy (L203), pressure-gradient terms PgrdX/PgrdY=9.80*(Depth+ETAmean)*d(ETAmean)/dx,y (L204-207), advective-flux gradients DxUUH/DyUVH/DyVVH/DxUVH of P_mean*P_mean/Max(Depth+ETAmean,MinDepthFrc) etc. (L208-223), and FRCXmean=FRCXmean*Cd, FRCYmean likewise (L224-225); resets the window: T_sum=T_sum-T_INTV_mean (ykchoi query 'T_sum=ZERO?' L235) and zeroes all sums (L236-253); computes significant wave height SigWaveHeight=4.004*SQRT(ETA2mean) (L255); zero-upcrossing statistics WaveHeightAve=HavgSum/Num_Zero_Up and WaveHeightRMS=SQRT(HrmsSum/Num_Zero_Up) where Num_Zero_Up>=2 (L258-268; per-window resets of the counters are commented out L264-266); CALL PREVIEW_MEAN (L270). ELSE branch (window still open, L272-314): accumulates the same sums (Usum..BreakDiss, L274-292; radiation calc added by fyshi 06/07/2022 per L280) and performs per-cell zero-upcrossing wave tracking: track Emax/Emin (L297-298), detect upward zero crossing of Eta-ETAmean via Tmpe>Tmp_0 and Tmpe*Tmp_0<=Zero (L299-301), increment Num_Zero_Up, add wave height Emax-Emin to HavgSum and its square to HrmsSum from the second crossing (L302-306), reset Emax=-1000., Emin=1000. for the next wave (L307-309).

verbatim_spans.text: !I think Umean, Vmean is not using in other routine.

unresolved: window-closing branch adds the final step to the sums and immediately computes means before resetting, but the reset keeps T_sum remainder (T_sum=T_sum-T_INTV_mean @L235, ykchoi's own comment questions whether it should be ZERO) — the first window after reset divides fresh sums by a T_sum that starts at the remainder, biasing the next means; unresolved intent
Num_Zero_Up/HavgSum/HrmsSum are never reset (reset lines commented out @L264-266), so WaveHeightAve/RMS are running statistics over the entire post-STEADY_TIME run, not per averaging window
UUsum etc. subtract U_davg_mean computed from the PREVIOUS window inside both branches (L171-173, L285-287) — first-window accumulations subtract the initial zero mean; cross-line dependency

MIXING_STUFF gate uses 'time' (lowercase) >= STEADY_TIME @L71 while the header comment says mean eta is also calculated — STEADY_TIME/T_INTV_mean default to LARGE in io.f90 so averaging is off unless configured (cross-file)
hard-coded 9.80 (L198,L204,L206) and 4.004 (L255) rather than GRAV — inconsistency with GRAV used elsewhere
Tmpe/Tmp_0 comparison uses Zero (capitalized) @L301 from PARAM (cross-file); DXg/DYg, Wsurf, BreakSourceX/Y, Cd, U_davg etc. all cross-file
